title: Registration is now open for the IFRA Global Fragrance Summit 2027
summary: The International Fragrance Association ( IFRA ) is excited to announce that registration is now open for the Global Fragrance Summit 2027 , which takes place at The St. Regis Mumbai, India, on 23 – 24 June 2027 .

extraction.key_fact: 국제향료협회가 인도 뭄바이에서 개최되는 글로벌 향료 서밋의 참가 등록을 시작했다.
